description: Use for one or several IBANs when no BIC is given. With a BIC, use check_payment_details. Offline check of up to 20 IBANs: format, length for the country and check digits. Optionally compares the account's country with the partner's country (argument partner: a country code or the partner's VAT ID) and flags a mismatch as a notice; without partner the result says that no comparison was made. It cannot verify who owns the account.

ibans.description: 1 to 20 IBANs, with or without spaces.

partner.description: Optional: the partner's two-letter country code or VAT ID, to compare with the account's country.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: check_iban
title: Check IBAN
